## 二、各分部增长驱动因素（引用电话会原文）

### 1. Productivity and Business Processes（收入 +14%，经营利润 +15%）

**驱动因素（Amy Hood 电话会原文）**：

> "Revenue from Productivity and Business Processes was $37.8 billion and grew 14%."

> "M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."

> "Building on our Copilot momentum from Q3, net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter. And paid M365 Commercial seats grew 6% year-over-year with installed base expansion across all customer segments, though primarily in our small and medium business and frontline worker offerings."

> "M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."

> "M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."

> "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."

> "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."

**利润驱动**：

> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains. Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."

**要点**：本分部是微软利润率最高的分部（57.9%），M365 Copilot 付费席位超 3,000 万（Satya Nadella 电话会："over 30 million paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats, with net seat adds more than doubling quarter-over-quarter"），驱动 ARPU 提升；但 Copilot 使用增加也小幅拉低毛利率。经营费用增速（+11%）低于收入增速（+14%），经营杠杆释放。

---

### 2. Intelligent Cloud（收入 +32%，经营利润 +31%）

**驱动因素（Amy Hood 电话会原文）**：

> "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**利润驱动**：

> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."

> "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%。"

**要点**：Azure 增速 43%（`metrics.txt`），连续多个季度加速。Satya Nadella 指出："Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"——这是本季度最核心的供需叙事。毛利率因 Azure 结构性占比提升和 AI 基础设施扩展而承压（57.1% vs 60.4%），但 Azure 内部效率提升部分对冲。经营利润率稳定在 41%，经营利润增速（+31%）与收入增速基本同步。值得注意的是，GitHub Copilot 在 6 月转为用量定价后消费超预期。

---

### 3. More Personal Computing（收入 -4%，经营利润 -14%）

**驱动因素（Amy Hood 电话会原文）**：

> "Revenue was $12.9 billion and declined 4% and 5% in constant currency."

> "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."

> "Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."

> "And in XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance。"

**利润驱动**：

> "Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition. Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX. Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%。"

**要点**：本分部是唯一下滑的分部。Windows OEM 同比 -5%，主因 PC 市场需求走弱 + Windows 10 支持终止带来的高基数效应（一年前已集中兑现）。Xbox 内容与服务同比 -10%，因去年同期第一方内容强势带来的高基数（FY25 Q4 含《Indiana Jones》《Forza Motorsport》等）。Satya Nadella 在电话会中明确表示："We are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth… we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027。"同时，本季度 Xbox 确认了减值与遣散费用（`press_release.txt`："severance expense and impairment charges in XBOX"）。搜索广告（+10%）是亮点，但受第三方合作关系影响增速放缓。经营利润率从 23.7% 降至 21.4%。

## 五、口径提示与使用注意事项

1. **分部收入为对外报告口径，不存在内部抵消**。三个分部收入之和严格等于全公司总收入（90,007），这是微软分部报告的特征——各分部面向外部客户独立核算。因此"分部之和 = 合计"是自然成立的，不需要额外的抵消项调整。

2. **毛利率不可跨分部直接比较**。Productivity & Business Processes 毛利率 81.5%（以授权和订阅为主），而 Intelligent Cloud 57.1%、More Personal Computing 56.0%（含大量转售硬件和云基础设施成本）。跨分部毛利率比较会误导——正确做法是与各自历史期间比较趋势。

3. **经营利润率同理**。57.9% vs 40.6% vs 21.4% 的差异反映的是业务模式差异（软件授权 vs 基础设施 vs 硬件/内容），而非经营效率优劣。

4. **各分部经营费用为"可归属经营费用"，不包含公司层面分摊**。全公司经营费用 19,879 恰好等于三个分部之和（8,958 + 6,475 + 4,446），说明微软将所有 R&D、销售市场、G&A 均已分摊至分部，公司层面无未分摊余额。但需注意，电话会中多次提及"shared R&D investments"（共享研发投资），说明这些 R&D 实际上跨分部服务，按微软内部方法计入各分部。

5. **同比增速已包含汇率影响**。本季 FX 基本中性（全公司收入 +18% vs 恒定汇率 +17%，仅差 1pp）。但 Xbox 内容与服务（恒定汇率 -11% vs 报告 -10%）和搜索广告（恒定汇率 +9% vs 报告 +10%）有一定汇率影响，解读时需留意。

6. **M365 Commercial 云报告增速 vs 调整增速**。报告口径 +14%，但调整了上年同期一次性确认 2 个百分点的收入后为 +16%。分析趋势时应使用调整口径，否则会低估真实增长。

7. **Xbox 的减值与遣散费用已计入本季度**。`press_release.txt` 明确指出本季度有 "severance expense and impairment charges in XBOX"，这是 More Personal Computing 经营利润下滑（-14%）的重要非经常性因素。剔除后经营利润下滑幅度会收窄。

8. **OpenAI 投资影响仅体现在净利润和其他收入中，不影响分部经营利润**。本季度 OpenAI 投资带来 +$480M 净利润影响（`press_release.txt`），Anthropic 投资带来 $3.2B 收益——这些均在"Other income (expense)"中，不影响分部经营利润和全公司经营利润（$40,603M）。因此分部经营利润是纯粹的经营性指标。

9. **资本支出与折旧口径**：本季度 CapEx $41B（含融资租赁），现金支付 P,P&E $35.8B；折旧摊销 $11.0B。FY27 起数据中心和办公楼使用寿命从 15 年延长至 25 年，将影响未来折旧节奏（对 FY27 经营利润影响极小），但本季度数据不受影响。

10. **前瞻性指引（FY27 Q1）**：Amy Hood 给出的下季指引——PBP 收入 $36.7–37.0B（+11–12%）、IC $40.95–41.25B（+33–34%）、MPC $12.2–12.7B——表明 Azure 加速至 ~45% 恒定汇率、Windows OEM 继续高个位数下滑、Xbox 内容与服务中个位数下滑的延续趋势。

---

## 六、结论摘要

- **Intelligent Cloud** 是本季最大亮点：收入 $39.3B 首次在单季超越 PBP，成为微软最大分部；Azure +43% 连续加速，需求远超供给，经营利润 +31%，经营利润率稳定在 41%。
- **Productivity & Business Processes** 稳健增长：M365 Copilot 超 3,000 万付费席位驱动 ARPU 提升，经营利润率 57.9% 为全公司最高，是微软利润压舱石。
- **More Personal Computing** 唯一下滑：受 Windows OEM 高基数和 Xbox 内容高基数双重拖累，叠加 Xbox 减值/遣散费用，经营利润 -14%。但搜索广告 +10% 显示 Bing/Edge 持续夺取份额。
- **全公司**：收入 $90.0B（+18%）、经营利润 $40.6B（+18%）、经营利润率 45.1%（+0.2pp），收入与经营利润同步增长。Microsoft Cloud 收入 $59.3B（+27%），商业剩余履约义务 $678B（+84%），为未来收入可见性提供强支撑。
